items.title: 6.7 Model ki jaanch aur karkardagi ke pemaane (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of model evaluation and performance metrics (PDF 85-86).

blocks.text: Model evaluation jaanchti hai ke machine learning model kitna achha kaam karta hai. Yeh un test data par model ke andazon ka miyar napti hai jo training mein use nahi hua, jis se model ki khoobiyan aur kamzoriyan saamne aati hain. Performance metrics woh pemaane hain jo use hote hain, aur mukhtalif masail ke liye mukhtalif metrics munasib hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Zyada accuracy wala model bhi kuch suraton mein ghalat nataij de sakta hai; isi liye precision aur recall jaise pemaane bhi use hote hain.

items: TP (true positives): positive cases jinhein durust positive kaha gaya.
TN (true negatives): negative cases jinhein durust negative kaha gaya.
FP (false positives): negative cases jinhein ghalti se positive kaha gaya (jhoota alarm).
FN (false negatives): positive cases jinhein ghalti se negative kaha gaya (chhoote cases).

blocks.text: Accuracy tamam andazon mein durust andazon ka hissa hai, aksar feesad mein: accuracy = (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN). Error rate ghalat andazon ka hissa hai, is liye error rate = 1 - accuracy. Akeli accuracy dhoka de sakti hai, khaas taur par jab aik class doosri se kaheen zyada aam ho, is liye ghaltiyon ka tajzia aur doosre pemaane bhi use hote hain.

items: Precision = TP / (TP + FP): positive kahe gaye cases mein se kitne waqai positive hain. Yeh durusti napti hai; zyada precision ka matlab kam jhoote alarm.
Recall = TP / (TP + FN): asal positive cases mein se kitne dhoonde gaye. Yeh mukammaliyat napti hai; zyada recall ka matlab kam chhoote cases.

F1-score = 2 x (precision x recall) / (precision + recall): aik score jo precision aur recall ka tawazun karta hai. Yeh khaas taur par na-mutawazin data mein mufeed hai, aur zyada F1-score behtar karkardagi hai.

blocks.alt: Do-ba-do confusion matrix, oopar predicted positive aur negative, pehlu mein actual positive aur negative: TP = 40 (durust positive), FN = 5 (chhoota positive), FP = 10 (jhoota alarm) aur TN = 50 (durust negative). Saath: accuracy = (TP + TN) / sab = 90 / 105 = 0.857; precision = TP / (TP + FP) = 40 / 50 = 0.8; recall = TP / (TP + FN) = 40 / 45 = 0.8889; F1 = 0.8421.
blocks.caption: Kitab ki misal ke liye confusion matrix aur metrics (6.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Precision 'predicted positive' column (TP aur FP) use karti; recall 'actual positive' row (TP aur FN) use karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Bimari ka test 20 bimaron mein se 18 dhoondta aur 980 sehatmand mein se 30 ko ghalti se bimar kehta hai. Recall aur precision nikalein. Yahan akeli accuracy kyun dhoka deti hai?
blocks.explanation: TP = 18, FN = 2, FP = 30, TN = 950. Recall = 18/20 = 0.9; precision = 18/48 = 0.375. Accuracy = 968/1000 = 0.968 sirf is liye shandar lagti hai ke zyada tar log sehatmand hain, jab ke zyada tar positive nataij jhoote alarm hain.

items: Accuracy = (TP + TN) / sab; error rate = 1 - accuracy.
Precision = TP / (TP + FP); recall = TP / (TP + FN); F1 dono ka tawazun (kitab ki misal 0.8, 0.8889, 0.8421).
